name: ICE detention population (ADP)
note: National average daily population in ICE detention, fiscal-YTD (FY2026), summed across 208 facilities and cross-checked against the workbook's second split. An average, not a point-in-time headcount.

annual_adp.source_note: Verified 12 Aug 2026 against ICE's own publications: FY2022/FY2023/FY2024 read directly from ICE Annual Report PDFs on ice.gov (FY2022 text 'an average of 22,630 people in ICE custody'; FY2023 text + Fig. 14; FY2024 Fig. 17 + text '~37,700'); FY2019-FY2021 from ICE FY2023 Annual Report Fig. 14 (CBP+ICE components, read directly) with FY2019/FY2020 corroborated by the ICE FY2020 ERO report's verbatim figures and CRS IN11335; FY2024 further corroborated by GAO-25-107580. Every value passes ICE's own component check: CBP-arrest ADP + ICE-arrest ADP sums exactly to the stated total.
